title: Prodigal Humanism — public research brief and argument ledger
governing_question: Can ethical and political commitments historically attributed to humanism be disentangled from the sovereignty of overrepresented Man and made answerable to historically constituted relations and distributions of bearing?
not_assumed: automatic moral conversion by repeated language
Prodigal Humanism as a completed independent philosophy
racialized man as uniform ahistorical category
a universal, human-exhaustive definition of personhood

claims.proposition: Historicize successive authoritative genres of Man and their institutions.
claims.burden: Identify historical cases, sources, institutional mechanisms and competing scholarship.

claims.proposition: Modernity's ethical categories may preserve sovereign allocations of recognition even when formally universal.
claims.burden: Specify category, era, mechanism, excluded/authorized populations, rival account and variation.

claims.proposition: The assessment of an arrangement should ask who bears its material and embodied costs, and whether an intervention actually changes their distribution.
claims.burden: Specify obligations, moral premises, empirical distributions and competing obligations.

claims.proposition: An AI's fluent articulation of witness, care or historical consciousness is insufficient to establish that it performs those capacities in a morally consequential way.
claims.burden: Design operational tests, counterexamples and limitations, without attributing subjective states.

review_process: Independently review provenance, inference, ontology and bearing. Preserve negative results, internal disputes and authorial correction.
privacy: Private Negromancy manuscript and personal testimony remain unpublished.
